g.text: Paste one public HTTPS page and inspect its title, icons, share images, metadata and crawl
signals in a dated report you can hand to an agent.
One requested page, bounded response sizes, no stored target content.
URL policy, dual DNS preflight and public-only fetch routing.
Readable findings plus JSON or Markdown export.
One-page inspection and local report · real capture
No database · no accounts · no stored pages
One public HTTPS URL, no private targets.
